partitions_five_way.monitor_role: descriptive only; monitor, 2022 score year, outer 2024 and sealed 2025 structurally unavailable to route selection

arm_hypotheses.evidence_pruned: EXPLORATORY (prospectively frozen from the M2 best cell's degraded pairs) — never confirmatory

common_probe_protocol.surface: ALL FIVE probes for EVERY route — cardinality never changes the exam (DATA-SOTA-369)
common_probe_protocol.encoder: FROZEN structurally (adapters fit on cached embeddings)

adapters.stopping: fixed step count, no early stop
adapters.capacity: single linear (rec/vol/barrier), monotone quantile head, 2-layer projection

common_probe_protocol.contrastive_probe: retrieval InfoNCE between intact and masked-view embeddings, temperature 0.2, exclusion 12
common_probe_protocol.refusals: missing/degenerate probe, non-convergent adapter, encoder output std < 1e-4 -> ROUTE REFUSED (surface never shrinks)

solo_references: 5 solo runs (single objective, same mechanism/budget/partitions) probed through the SAME surface; reference for probe k = solo-k encoder's own-task probe score, per family, bound BEFORE route ranking
ranking_per_family_lexicographic: 1) count of common probes degraded beyond the frozen 1.2 rule (route probe score / solo reference)
acceptance: a route is mechanically acceptable only if NO common probe is materially degraded AND representation/activity gates pass; if none acceptable -> STOP, negative result, no post-hoc tuning
